operation: APK-first current original default sword/staff standalone/integrated UI source hierarchies and shared model. Fully decode original inline binary, retain every bone/skin/attachment/constraint/animation and atlas region; native carrier retains complete metadata. Resolve actual high texture GUIDs through original AppearanceUILite loader; preserve placeholders and original texture settings/mips. Translate original executable GLES height-clip shader and original UI material values to Windows. Source hierarchy metadata is retained for subsequent prefab/component conversion, not instantiated as a substitute UI.
limitations: Only two default weapon pages are packaged; other skins remain in the lossless data but unavailable pages fail explicitly.
Default skins have no active constraints; constrained weapon skins, physics/mixing, production SkeletonGraphic/AppearanceUILite and full original weapon prefab/part pool still require conversion.
Complete profession page/input/save and Windows release remain incomplete.
validated_scope: Unity 2022.3.57f1c2 actual Direct3D Play Mode passed four original UI source hierarchies and complete shared model/atlas loading; both default weapon skins across all six inline actions, 96 reverse sampled frames and 1536 independent world matrices, maximum scalar difference 0.00004577637; all four GPU mip hashes, 1021792 exact bytes; 16 original shader variants, 32 Windows D3D executable stages; two actual original weapon captures inspected. Original six character-idle curve regression passed 1171 tracks/19537 independent samples, maximum absolute difference 0.0000152587891. Original character application/native graph regression passed 96 pre-physics frames/9768 matrices, maximum scalar difference 0.0006952286, 48576 mesh vertices and four inspected core-character captures. Global validation and static root 74856/frozen 73826 GUID checks passed. Native weapon prefab/Graphic/AppearanceUILite/pool and full page/input/save/Windows release remain incomplete.
native_curve_precision: Retain Unity weighted key representation and the original absolute handles. Evaluate cubic time inversion directly in double precision without resampling/baking: a real weapon translation at t=3.2 differed by 0.00413 source units with AnimationCurve.Evaluate and failed the existing independent tolerance. Source key records are copied so callers cannot mutate the exact sampler after construction. Linear/stepped native evaluation and original boundary non-application remain unchanged; character-curve/application-graph regressions are required.
